description: This file defines the PageModel class for the checkout process in an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages application, handling basket retrieval, order creation, and checkout logic.

classes.name: CheckoutModel
classes.description: PageModel class managing the checkout process, including basket retrieval, order creation, and checkout actions.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to initialize the basket view model for the checkout page.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process the checkout form, updating basket quantities and creating an order.

methods.name: SetBasketModelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves or creates the basket for the current user or anonymous session.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Ensures the user has a unique basket cookie and username for anonymous sessions.
